NYR.head: The Rangers should be in control
NYR.body: The Rangers have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage, while Vancouver is on the second night of a back-to-back. It’s on the Canucks to make it a game, and they can if they get good looks.

VAN.head: A steep climb for the Canucks
VAN.body: The Rangers have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage, while Vancouver is on the second night of a back-to-back. To pull this off, the Canucks can start with getting good looks, plus a goalie who steals the show.
